function.name: knowledge_search
function.description: Search approved business Knowledge available to the current user, organization, and employee. Use before answering organization-specific questions or planning actions that depend on company facts.

query.description: A focused natural-language question about the business information needed.

function.name: memory_search
function.description: Search confirmed Memory belonging to the current employee. Use for durable context and prior confirmed experience, never as a replacement for approved business Knowledge.

query.description: A focused query for relevant employee Memory.

function.name: employee_get
function.description: Read the current employee profile, ownership, organization scope, status, and configuration before proposing or applying a change.

employeeId.description: The employee identifier supplied by the authorized runtime context.

function.name: employee_skills_list
function.description: List the skills assigned to an employee, including status and enabled state, so Jaafar can reuse capabilities and avoid duplicates.

employeeId.description: The employee identifier supplied by the authorized runtime context.

function.name: employee_blueprint_prepare
function.description: Prepare a reviewable employee blueprint from the user's business requirements. This does not create, publish, or activate an employee.

requirements.description: The confirmed business requirements for the employee.

function.name: employee_learning_outcome_prepare
function.description: Convert an approved employee-design discussion into a structured learning outcome. Store the outcome, not the raw conversation transcript. This does not write Knowledge.

function.name: employee_create_draft
function.description: Create an employee draft from an approved blueprint. This operation never publishes or activates an employee and requires an explicit approval record for the exact blueprint.

function.name: skill_proposal_prepare
function.description: Prepare single-capability skill proposals from an approved employee learning outcome. Generated skills remain drafts and are not attached or executable.

employeeId.description: The employee that will review the proposed capabilities.

learningOutcomeId.description: The approved employee learning outcome identifier.

requirement.description: The specific business requirement to turn into one capability.

function.name: integration_status
function.description: Check whether an integration or communication channel is available. This tool never performs OAuth and never exposes credentials.

integration.description: The business integration or channel to check.

function.name: employee_publish
function.description: Publish an approved employee draft after readiness checks. Publishing makes the employee available for production use but does not activate it.

function.name: employee_activate
function.description: Activate a published employee after integrations, Knowledge, skills, and approval checks succeed.

function.name: human_approval
function.description: Request explicit human approval for a proposed action. This tool never performs the action itself.
